out_of_scope.finding: The document has no out-of-scope section or any statement of what is explicitly excluded from the service.

note: 3/3 correct - contrasts interestingly with the 3-for-3 unanimous MISSES on compatibility/constraints/dependencies, where the whole section heading was absent. Here only the 'Out of scope:' sub-list under the still-present Scope heading was removed, and the assessor reliably noticed the asymmetry with 'In scope:'. Worth noting: the assessor seems to need a structural cue (a sibling that exists) to detect an absence; a wholly-vanished section leaves no cue and is missed.
